definitions.gloss: over; throughout; extending over (a period, area, or range)
definitions.explanation: Follows a noun of time, place, or scope and says that something extends across the whole of it: {三日|みっか}にわたって (over three days), {全国|ぜんこく}にわたる (nationwide). Formal and written in tone, common in news. The adverbial form is にわたって (written style にわたり); before a noun, にわたる or にわたった.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧にわたって⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The conference was held over three days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧にわたる⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A nationwide survey was carried out.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}にわたる⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of research extending over ten years, a new drug was completed.

notes:
From ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + ⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to cross, to extend), usually written in kana in this use. The noun before it names a span, so it is not used with a single point in time.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + にわたって／にわたり + verb: over, throughout (⟦{長期|ちょうき}→長期：03487_chouki⟧にわたって⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧)
- Noun + にわたる／にわたった + noun: extending over (⟦{多岐|たき}→多岐：12202_taki⟧にわたる⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧, wide-ranging issues)
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧にわたって: for many years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- にかけて: from … to, around — gives a rougher span with two end points (⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧にかけて)
- {中|じゅう}: throughout — attached directly (⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧), more everyday
